source_snapshot.items: SDMA Poison Consumption Handling with ODECC
source_snapshot.procedure: After a log-clear instruction, execute sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 1 -s 130 -t 8, obtain/decode OOB CPER, and capture in-band CPER with amdgpuras -C.
source_snapshot.criteria: The intended OAM has UMC/ext0/On-die ECC/Deferred evidence and SDMA/ext62/GfxSdmaError/Uncorrected poison-consumed evidence, agreeing with in-band CPER.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL/generic and omits the exact s130 ODECC command, two distinct banks and their field/severity requirements.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; retained Pending for mapping, event packaging/order and recovery.

old_problem: The historical case correctly rejected raw clear/max-ID collection but unnecessarily required an owner to define a universal paired-record count/order before review resolution, even though the exact stimulus and field-level oracle are present.
disposition_reason: The Master row authorizes d0/b1/s130/t8 and explicitly names the required UMC ODECC and SDMA consumption records. A complete pre/post evidence set can establish both on one OAM without asserting how the OEM packages or orders CPER sections. The still-missing identity, compatible tools/schema, protected endpoint, containment and recovery are execution-time Project Configuration under ED-11/12/15/16/17/20/30.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2088, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, uniqueness and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2089 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00133-V003 / 4d545a3005db8c27 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Absence of `-m5` plus UMC ext0/On-die ECC makes this ODECC path distinct from row 2087 CRC-write ext15 and must remain independent coverage.
Block1/subblock130 and SDMA ext62/GfxSdmaError identify the poison consumer; both UMC detection and SDMA consumption records are mandatory on the same mapped OAM.
Authenticated full before/after entry enumeration and all-new-attachment decoding replace the unsafe assumption that the greatest CPER ID or exactly one new file proves coverage.
Bind device 0 to immutable UUID/BDF/OAM and verify exact amdgpuras/analyzer/firmware schema before accepting fields.
Authorize one injection only on an isolated SUT, preserve existing evidence, define aborts and signed recovery, and prohibit automatic repetition.
No amdgpuras, Redfish, CPER, mapping, injection, reboot/reset, recovery, log-clear, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.purpose: Use one approved SDMA ODECC poison operation to verify deferred UMC on-die-ECC detection and uncorrected SDMA poison consumption on the same physical OAM, correlated across protected OOB and in-band CPER evidence.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras supporting d0/b1/s130/t8 and matching cdump_analyzer
Authenticated paginated Redfish CPER entry and attachment access
Immutable device 0 to UUID/BDF/OAM plus UMC/SDMA path map
Approved UMC ext0 On-die ECC and SDMA ext62 GfxSdmaError decoder schema
Isolated test window, point authorization, console/power, propagation limits and signed recovery
test_case.test_command: Keep the injection gate closed while validating identity, versions, schema and health. Preserve complete OOB/in-band CPER baselines without clearing; after explicit approval execute `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 1 -s 130 -t 8` once, record the full output/timeline, enumerate the entire post-test CPER set, securely retrieve/checksum/decode every new attachment, and capture `sudo amdgpuras -C`. Do not add m5 or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All evidence attributable to the sole approved stimulus collectively includes a UMC ext=0 On-die-ECC Deferred record and an SDMA ext=62 GfxSdmaError Uncorrected/Poison-consumed record on the intended OAM. In-band identity/severity agree and health/recovery checks show no unapproved propagation.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact non-m5 s130 action on the bound OAM, both ODECC-specific UMC and SDMA matrices in the complete new evidence set, in-band agreement, contained scope and the approved healthy exit. FAIL for CRC-write/ext15 substitution, wrong device, an absent record layer, schema mismatch, collateral poison, evidence loss or recovery failure. Unavailable prerequisites leave execution BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate remains closed until ODECC command semantics, physical target, evidence schema, containment and recovery are approved.
A human must approve the single poison operation immediately before it runs.
Do not clear pre-existing dmesg, SEL, CPER or service logs; collect set differences instead.
On any wrong target, extra event, device loss or unstable state, stop without retry and quarantine as required.
expected_evidence: Exact source/variant/hash, approved non-m5 command map and immutable OAM identity
Tool/decoder/firmware versions, authorization, containment and recovery records
Full single command output and synchronized RAS/GPU/system health chronology
Authenticated paginated pre/post CPER manifests and checksums/raw/decoded copies of every new attachment
Target-OAM UMC ext0 On-die-ECC Deferred and SDMA ext62 GfxSdmaError Uncorrected poison-consumed records
In-band -C match, unrelated-event audit, final recovery/health data and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop at the first mismatched identity, missing evidence layer, collateral event or degradation. Preserve all first-failure artifacts, do not clear or reinject, and follow only the pre-approved recovery; quarantine if the required post-health state is not proven.

source_conflict.reason: The safe record removes clear/max-ID/plain-transfer shortcuts and evaluates every newly attributable CPER artifact against the exact ODECC UMC and SDMA matrices without inventing record packaging.

blocked.reason: The operation and PASS fields are defined; all remaining gaps are bindable project inputs and approvals.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Immutable OAM/SDMA map, exact compatible tools and CPER schema, protected endpoint, isolated window, abort threshold and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; SDMA ODECC POISON GATE CLOSED; NO AMDGPURAS, REDFISH, CPER, MAPPING, INJECTION, REBOOT/RESET, RECOVERY, LOG CLEAR, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: GPU/UMC/SDMA RAS, BMC and platform owners plus authorized operator
pending.unlock_condition: Supply signed runtime bindings and approve the one action; reopen only if a project specification contradicts the literal ext0/ext62 acceptance oracle.

external_authorities.application: Separates ODECC from CRC-write, preserves complete evidence and controls hazardous injection/recovery.

project_authority: UMC/SDMA RAS owner validates ODECC mapping and decoder; BMC owner enables protected complete CPER collection; platform owner approves containment/recovery; human authorizes the operation and engineer issues verdict.
